items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Vanilla flavoring' to USDA SR Legacy 'Vanilla extract'. This target's own pinned evidence independently contains vanilla extract at rank 1, and the current semantic-history proposal independently points to the same exact FDC record from prior reviewed Cook4Me 'Vanilla' (M_FOOD_484). Candidate rank and historical reuse are review aids only, not identity proof. Confidence remains medium because generic 'flavoring' does not prove that the ingredient is specifically natural vanilla extract; this continuation does not infer natural/artificial flavor composition, alcohol carrier, sugar, concentration, brand, or formulation.
